title: Peanut allergy rate by age 5: avoidance vs. early consumption

source.name: Randomized Trial of Peanut Consumption in Infants at Risk for Peanut Allergy (the LEAP study)
source.publisher: New England Journal of Medicine (Du Toit et al., 2015)

notes: Learning Early About Peanut Allergy (LEAP) randomized trial: among high-risk infants (severe eczema and/or egg allergy) with a negative baseline peanut skin-prick test, 13.7% of the peanut-avoidance group had developed peanut allergy by 60 months of age, versus 1.9% of the early-consumption group -- an 81% relative risk reduction, the finding that flipped US infant-feeding guidance.
